def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements a non-recursive state machine approach for regex matching.
    Supports literal characters, '.' (any character), '*' (zero or more of the preceding element),
    and '+' (one or more of the preceding element).
    """

    p_len, t_len = len(pattern), len(text)
    s_idx = 0  # index for text
    p_idx = 0  # index for pattern
    star_idx = -1  # position of '*' in pattern
    match_idx = 0  # position in text when '*' is encountered

    while s_idx < t_len:
        if p_idx < p_len and (pattern[p_idx] == text[s_idx] or pattern[p_idx] == '.'):
            s_idx += 1
            p_idx += 1
        elif p_idx < p_len and pattern[p_idx] == '*':
            star_idx = p_idx
            match_idx = s_idx
            p_idx += 1
        elif star_idx != -1:
            p_idx = star_idx + 1
            s_idx = match_idx + 1
            match_idx += 1
        else:
            return False

    while p_idx < p_len and pattern[p_idx] == '*':
        p_idx += 1

    return p_idx == p_len

def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements a two-pointer iterative approach for regex matching.
    Supports literal characters, '.' (any character), '*' (zero or more of the preceding element),
    and '+' (one or more of the preceding element).
    """

    p_len, t_len = len(pattern), len(text)
    p_idx, t_idx = 0, 0
    last_star_idx = -1  # last position of '*' in the pattern
    last_match_idx = 0  # text index after matching '*'

    while t_idx < t_len:
        if p_idx < p_len and (pattern[p_idx] == text[t_idx] or pattern[p_idx] == '.'):
            p_idx += 1
            t_idx += 1
        elif p_idx < p_len and pattern[p_idx] == '*':
            last_star_idx = p_idx
            last_match_idx = t_idx
            p_idx += 1
        elif last_star_idx != -1:
            p_idx = last_star_idx + 1
            t_idx = last_match_idx + 1
            last_match_idx += 1
        else:
            return False

    while p_idx < p_len and pattern[p_idx] == '*':
        p_idx += 1

    return p_idx == p_len
